name: production-plus
title: Production Plus
author: Reiji_Kishigami
description: Replaces the production window with one that adds a Net panel (produced minus consumed) next to production and consumption, so you can see deficits and surpluses at a glance. Also adds search, a sortable table view, click-to-graph and pinning, lock and flip, quality filters, a Power tab with every electric network, CSV export, and a one-click switch back to vanilla. Built to look like vanilla and stay lightweight.
